purpose: Conceptual editorial cover, used in the article hero, homepage Studio feature and Synaptic index. Not a scientific figure.
generator: Image generation tool; one generated asset selected and inspected.
brief_summary: A museum-like scientific sculpture: an opened translucent research chamber expanding into luminous paths, mathematical surfaces and a molecular ribbon. Main composition on the right, quiet left for typeset headline. Midnight navy, gold, cyan and restrained violet. No generated lettering, logos, people or robots; conceptual rather than a faithful molecular structure.
transform: Converted to WebP at original 1672 × 941 dimensions. Headlines and labels are HTML, not baked into the asset.
scientific_figures: Three.js/SVG/HTML derived from stated equations, deposited coordinates and explicit scenarios; no generated scientific measurements or molecular imagery.
